<html xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml"><body><html:div xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" class="eli-subdivision" id="rct_34">
               <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                  <html:col width="4%" />
                  <html:col width="96%" />
                  <html:tbody>
                     <html:tr>
                        <html:td valign="top">
                           <html:p class="oj-normal">(34)</html:p>
                        </html:td>
                        <html:td valign="top">
                           <html:p class="oj-normal">Provision should be made to ensure transparency as regards the use of category 1 NGT plant varieties in order to ensure that production chains that wish to remain free from NGT plants and NGT products can do so, and thereby safeguard consumer trust. NGT plants that have obtained a declaration of category 1 NGT plant status should be listed in a publicly available database. That database should contain, inter alia, information on the techniques used to obtain the traits. For transparency reasons, the patent information and the licence declarations provided by the requester should also be included in the database and be kept up to date, without any responsibility on the part of the Commission for the accuracy of that information and subject to the caveat that this information is limited only to what the requester was aware of. To ensure traceability, transparency and choice for operators, during research and plant breeding, when selling plant reproductive material to farmers or making it available to third parties in any other way, plant reproductive material of category 1 NGT plants should be labelled as such.</html:p>
                        </html:td>
                     </html:tr>
                  </html:tbody>
               </html:table>
            </html:div>
            <html:div xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" class="eli-subdivision" id="art_30">
                  <html:p id="d1e2396-1-1" class="oj-ti-art">Article 30</html:p>
                  <html:div class="eli-title" id="art_30.tit_1">
                     <html:p class="oj-sti-art">Code of conduct</html:p>
                  </html:div>
                  <html:div id="030.001">
                     <html:p class="oj-normal">1.   The Commission, in cooperation with the Member States, shall oversee the drawing-up of a code of conduct at Union level to enhance the transparency of information relating to patents on plant biological material, to facilitate breeders’ access to such material and to enhance legal certainty for breeders and farmers (‘code of conduct’).</html:p>
                  </html:div>
                  <html:div id="030.002">
                     <html:p class="oj-normal">2.   The Commission shall invite the owners of patents relating to NGT plants, representatives of voluntary platforms for the licensing of patents on plant biological material, plant breeder and farmer organisations as well as other civil society organisations and other interested parties, as appropriate, to participate on a voluntary basis in the drawing-up of the code of conduct.</html:p>
                  </html:div>
                  <html:div id="030.003">
                     <html:p class="oj-normal">3.   The Commission shall aim that the code of conduct include the following commitments by patent owners:</html:p>
                     <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                        <html:col width="4%" />
                        <html:col width="96%" />
                        <html:tbody>
                           <html:tr>
                              <html:td valign="top">
                                 <html:p class="oj-normal">(a)</html:p>
                              </html:td>
                              <html:td valign="top">
                                 <html:p class="oj-normal">the provision of clear, comprehensive and publicly accessible information on patents and patent applications covering biological material incorporated in plant varieties placed on the market in the Union;</html:p>
                              </html:td>
                           </html:tr>
                        </html:tbody>
                     </html:table>
                     <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                        <html:col width="4%" />
                        <html:col width="96%" />
                        <html:tbody>
                           <html:tr>
                              <html:td valign="top">
                                 <html:p class="oj-normal">(b)</html:p>
                              </html:td>
                              <html:td valign="top">
                                 <html:p class="oj-normal">arrangements for the licensing of patents under fair and reasonable conditions, including through the voluntary platforms referred to in paragraph 2;</html:p>
                              </html:td>
                           </html:tr>
                        </html:tbody>
                     </html:table>
                     <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                        <html:col width="4%" />
                        <html:col width="96%" />
                        <html:tbody>
                           <html:tr>
                              <html:td valign="top">
                                 <html:p class="oj-normal">(c)</html:p>
                              </html:td>
                              <html:td valign="top">
                                 <html:p class="oj-normal">the amicable settlement of patent disputes involving breeders which are SMEs, or involving farmers in the case of unintentional minor presence of patented biological material in their fields.</html:p>
                              </html:td>
                           </html:tr>
                        </html:tbody>
                     </html:table>
                  </html:div>
                  <html:div id="030.004">
                     <html:p class="oj-normal">4.   The Commission shall aim that the code of conduct include the following commitments by voluntary platforms for the licensing of plant biological material:</html:p>
                     <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                        <html:col width="4%" />
                        <html:col width="96%" />
                        <html:tbody>
                           <html:tr>
                              <html:td valign="top">
                                 <html:p class="oj-normal">(a)</html:p>
                              </html:td>
                              <html:td valign="top">
                                 <html:p class="oj-normal">cost-attractive fees for participation in the platforms to facilitate participation in the platforms by breeders which are SMEs;</html:p>
                              </html:td>
                           </html:tr>
                        </html:tbody>
                     </html:table>
                     <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                        <html:col width="4%" />
                        <html:col width="96%" />
                        <html:tbody>
                           <html:tr>
                              <html:td valign="top">
                                 <html:p class="oj-normal">(b)</html:p>
                              </html:td>
                              <html:td valign="top">
                                 <html:p class="oj-normal">standard licence agreements;</html:p>
                              </html:td>
                           </html:tr>
                        </html:tbody>
                     </html:table>
                     <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                        <html:col width="4%" />
                        <html:col width="96%" />
                        <html:tbody>
                           <html:tr>
                              <html:td valign="top">
                                 <html:p class="oj-normal">(c)</html:p>
                              </html:td>
                              <html:td valign="top">
                                 <html:p class="oj-normal">fair and impartial mechanisms for settling disagreements on licensing fees.</html:p>
                              </html:td>
                           </html:tr>
                        </html:tbody>
                     </html:table>
                  </html:div>
                  <html:div id="030.005">
                     <html:p class="oj-normal">5.   The Commission shall aim that the code of conduct set out its objectives, contain indicators to measure the achievement of those objectives, take due account of the needs and interests of all interested parties at Union level, including plant breeders and farmers, and provide a reporting framework to ensure that participants annually report to the Commission on any measures taken to implement the code of conduct and their outcomes, including aggregated information on licences granted under the arrangements referred to in paragraph 3, point (b). The Commission may provide recommendations to operators in the drawing-up of the code of conduct.</html:p>
                  </html:div>
                  <html:div id="030.006">
                     <html:p class="oj-normal">6.   The Commission shall monitor the rate of participation in, and the functioning of, the code of conduct and the achievement of its aims, as referred to in paragraphs 1 to 5.</html:p>
                  </html:div>
                  <html:div id="030.007">
                     <html:p class="oj-normal">7.   By … [seven years from the date of entry into force of this Regulation] and every five years thereafter, the Commission shall publish a report on the evaluation of the functioning of the code of conduct. In its evaluation, the Commission shall examine the results of the drawing-up of the code of conduct referred to in paragraphs 1 to 5 and of the monitoring referred to in paragraph 6. In this context, the Commission shall also assess if and to what extent provisions covered in the code of conduct have been infringed and if the code of conduct has ensured fair and reasonable access to patented NGT plant biological material. The report shall be accompanied, where appropriate, by legislative proposals to safeguard the good functioning of the sector, in particular access to patented NGT plant biological material for primary users, including farmers.</html:p>
                  </html:div>
                  <html:div id="030.008">
                     <html:p class="oj-normal">8.   The code of conduct shall be ready by … [18 months from the date of entry into force of this Regulation].</html:p>
                  </html:div>
               </html:div>
               <html:div xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" class="eli-subdivision" id="art_37">
                  <html:p id="d1e2682-1-1" class="oj-ti-art">Article 37</html:p>
                  <html:div class="eli-title" id="art_37.tit_1">
                     <html:p class="oj-sti-art">Amendments to Regulation (EU) 2017/625</html:p>
                  </html:div>
                  <html:p class="oj-normal">Article 23 of Regulation (EU) 2017/625 is amended as follows:</html:p>
                  <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                     <html:col width="4%" />
                     <html:col width="96%" />
                     <html:tbody>
                        <html:tr>
                           <html:td valign="top">
                              <html:p class="oj-normal">(1)</html:p>
                           </html:td>
                           <html:td valign="top">
                              <html:p class="oj-normal">in paragraph 2, point (a)(ii) is replaced by the following:</html:p>
                              <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                 <html:col width="4%" />
                                 <html:col width="96%" />
                                 <html:tbody>
                                    <html:tr>
                                       <html:td valign="top">
                                          <html:p class="oj-normal">‘(ii)</html:p>
                                       </html:td>
                                       <html:td valign="top">
                                          <html:p class="oj-normal">the cultivation of GMOs for food and feed production and the correct application of the plan for monitoring referred to in Article 13(2), point (e), of Directive 2001/18/EC, in Article 5(5), point (b), and Article 17(5), point (b), of Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003 and in Article 14(1), point (h), and Article 20(3), point (b), of Regulation (EU) 2026/… of the European Parliament and of the Council<html:a id="ntc*1-C_202602550EN.000101-E0031" href="#ntr*1-C_202602550EN.000101-E0031"> (<html:span class="oj-super oj-note-tag">*1</html:span>)</html:a>;</html:p>
                                       </html:td>
                                    </html:tr>
                                 </html:tbody>
                              </html:table>
                              <html:p class="oj-note">
                                 <html:a id="ntr*1-C_202602550EN.000101-E0031" href="#ntc*1-C_202602550EN.000101-E0031" class="oj-quotation">(<html:span class="oj-super">*1</html:span>)</html:a>  Regulation (EU) 2026/… of the European Parliament and of the Council of … on plants obtained by certain new genomic techniques and their products, and amending Regulation (EU) 2017/625 (OJ L, …, ELI: …)<html:a id="ntc-" href="#ntr-"> (<html:span class="oj-super oj-note-tag" />)</html:a>.’;"
                        </html:p>
                           </html:td>
                        </html:tr>
                     </html:tbody>
                  </html:table>
                  <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                     <html:col width="4%" />
                     <html:col width="96%" />
                     <html:tbody>
                        <html:tr>
                           <html:td valign="top">
                              <html:p class="oj-normal">(2)</html:p>
                           </html:td>
                           <html:td valign="top">
                              <html:p class="oj-normal">in paragraph 3, point (b) is replaced by the following:</html:p>
                              <html:table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                 <html:col width="4%" />
                                 <html:col width="96%" />
                                 <html:tbody>
                                    <html:tr>
                                       <html:td valign="top">
                                          <html:p class="oj-normal">‘(b)</html:p>
                                       </html:td>
                                       <html:td valign="top">
                                          <html:p class="oj-normal">the cultivation of GMOs for food and feed production and the correct application of the plan for monitoring referred to in Article 13(2), point (e), of Directive 2001/18/EC, in Article 5(5), point (b), and Article 17(5), point (b), of Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003 and in Article 14(1), point (h), and Article 20(3), point (b), of Regulation (EU) 2026/… <html:a id="ntc++-C_202602550EN.000101-E0033" href="#ntr++-C_202602550EN.000101-E0033">(<html:span class="oj-super oj-note-tag">++</html:span>)</html:a>;’.</html:p>
                                       </html:td>
                                    </html:tr>
                                 </html:tbody>
                              </html:table>
                           </html:td>
                        </html:tr>
                     </html:tbody>
                  </html:table>
               </html:div>
               <html:div xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" class="eli-subdivision" id="art_38">
                  <html:p id="d1e2734-1-1" class="oj-ti-art">Article 38</html:p>
                  <html:div class="eli-title" id="art_38.tit_1">
                     <html:p class="oj-sti-art">Entry into force and application</html:p>
                  </html:div>
                  <html:p class="oj-normal">This Regulation shall enter into force on the twentieth day following that of its publication in the <html:span class="oj-italic">Official Journal of the European Union</html:span>.</html:p>
                  <html:p class="oj-normal">It shall apply from … [24 months from the date of entry into force of this Regulation]. However, Articles 29, 30 and 31 shall apply from … [the date of entry into force of this Regulation].</html:p>
               </html:div>
            <html:div xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" class="eli-container" id="anx_II">
            <html:p class="oj-doc-ti" id="d1e38-38-1">ANNEX II</html:p>
            <html:p class="oj-doc-ti">Traits referred to in Article 3, point (13)(a), that exclude NGT plants from category 1 status</html:p>
            <html:div class="oj-enumeration-spacing">
               <html:p style="display: inline;">(1)   </html:p>
               <html:p style="display: inline;">
                  <html:span>Tolerance to herbicides</html:span>
               </html:p>
            </html:div>
            <html:div class="oj-enumeration-spacing">
               <html:p style="display: inline;">(2)   </html:p>
               <html:p style="display: inline;">
                  <html:span>Production of a known insecticidal substance</html:span>
               </html:p>
            </html:div>
         </html:div>
      </body></html>
